root: ^Do you ever think about what’s up there?
^But… what do you think is in that blue?
^know a trout that jumps out into the dry. They say there’s another seabed up there.
^Really? With sand and coral and everything?
^Yeah but the coral is super big, and the fish are weird.
^I’m telling you, there must be a god! Look around you, someone had to have designed all of this beauty!
^I’ll admit, it's too perfect. All the different fishes, different personalities, beautiful landscapes; it had to be made by a god.
^I was runner-up. There was a fish that was bigger.
^Why is that always the way it is?
^Barry, psst, don’t look but there’s a weird, furry fish staring at us.
^It has some tentacles. Maybe it’s a cephalopod?
^Whatever it is, I want it to go away.
